cell_rule: unchanged SEG-072: positive when any I, negative when every byte is D, else masked

cell_weights.definition: weight 1.0 iff the cell label rests on strong tiers only (positive with an E start; negative of only H/M bytes)

arms.T: base + SEG-072 complete Sonic 2 truth (reference only)

diagnostic.folds: leave-one-lineage-out over the qualified non-Sonic lineages (every qualified lineage except D01); train = the other non-Sonic qualified lineages (truth labels) + the arm's Sonic 2 labels; the Sonic lineage (s1, sk, s2 truth) never enters the base pool
diagnostic.in_image_note: an additional non-blind check scores the Sonic 2 cells that the arm left unlabelled against truth; not generalisation evidence
diagnostic.metrics: per held-out lineage and pooled over held-out cells: average precision and ROC AUC of the cell score against truth cell labels
diagnostic.model: SEG-072 model A = M1 HistGradientBoostingClassifier over the multiscale aggregates (frozen HGB_CONFIG); masked cells excluded
diagnostic.not_claimed: no blind generalisation (Sonic 2 is already in SEG-072); no A/B/C retraining; one game; one seed set
diagnostic.weights: sample_weight = cell weight; B0 and T use 1.0

inputs: existing private Sonic 2 label directories from ADR 0182's runs (TAS, seed-1 control, seed-2 control); no retracing

limits.retraining: none beyond the minimal model-A arms

measure: coverage lost when weak tiers are excluded (bytes and cells)
per-tier errors split into code-as-data / data-as-code / wrong I-c
weak-negative cells containing truth code (training-label noise)
extra correct code-positive, mixed and hard-negative cells (TAS minus control, cells with a wrong label excluded), per variant
code and data errors are always reported separately
preserves: ADR 0181 (REPLAY_INVALID) and ADR 0182 (LABELS_UNSAFE) are unchanged; this is a training-label layer, not a revised Gate B; generated-native code admission is untouched and fail-closed

recommendation_rule.A_clean_strong_tier: strong tiers E/H/M have zero code-as-data and data-as-code bytes and the E I/c wrong rate <= 0.001
recommendation_rule.B_coverage: the strong variant keeps >= 50% of the weak variant's TAS-over-control extra correct code-positive cells
recommendation_rule.C_no_harm: pooled AP of S_tas >= pooled AP of B0 - 0.005 and >= pooled AP of S_ctl - 0.005
recommendation_rule.verdict: single different-engine TAS pilot recommended iff A and B and C; otherwise not recommended until the failing part is fixed

tiers.R: direct static reach I/c: weak code
tiers.W: ordinary observed data read: weak, nonexclusive data

truth_use: evaluator only (`measure`, `diagnose` scoring); never used to form, repair or filter training labels

variants.weak: strong + R + W; code always wins a byte; W never vetoes a code cell
